key_insight: Compact symmetry-based descriptors can be inverted to reconstruct local atomic environments accurately, even when the representation is incomplete or locally ill-conditioned.
engineering_relevance: This enables interpretable atomistic ML features and provides a practical route to diagnose degeneracies and geometry sensitivity in materials and molecular models.
method: Invert invariant descriptors such as power spectrum/bispectrum back to point clouds
Use compact radial/angular bases with only tens of features
Compare reconstructions across different correlation orders to probe ambiguity and distortion
evidence_signal: The abstract reports accurate reconstructions across molecular and materials datasets using remarkably compact descriptors, including formally incomplete and locally ill-conditioned ones.
watch_item: Reconstruction quality depends on basis choice and discretization, and approximate degeneracies mean different atomic environments may map to similar descriptors.
paper_title: Reconstructing local environments from concise atomistic representations
